agent_report.summary: Fixed Issue #44: completed priorities/tasks now sink to the bottom of their own list (incomplete items in insertion order, completed items in reverse-insertion order, matching the Issue's worked example) via a read-time-only view in state.js's getDay. Along the way found and fixed a real bug: every writer (addItem/setNote/toggleItem/removeItem/moveItem) was building on getDay's already-sunk view and storing that back, silently baking render order into state.days on each toggle — fixed by adding an internal rawDay used by all writers so storage stays in true insertion order. Added a large-day test suite (40 tasks/3 priorities/8 commitments/12 deadlines) confirming usability at 360/768/1024/1280px with no CSS changes needed, plus ordering/storage/count-invariant tests. All 132 tests pass locally. Documented reasoning in DECISIONS.md. Opened PR #45 (branch ant/issue-44), CI running.
